description: This file defines the Acknowledgement interface within a Java project, which represents acknowledgment responses (ACK/NACK) in a system handling entity communications. It includes methods for creating acknowledgements, retrieving labels, status, entity information, and JSON serialization, serving as a central component for acknowledgment handling.

classes.name: Acknowledgement
classes.description: An interface representing acknowledgment responses (ACK/NACK) with methods for creation, retrieval, and JSON serialization, including label, status, entity info, and payload.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns a string representing the type of acknowledgment for a specific entity type.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new Acknowledgement instance with specified label, entity ID, status code, headers, and optional payload.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Retrieves the label of the acknowledgment, indicating its type or custom label.

methods.name: isSuccess
methods.description: Determines if the acknowledgment indicates a success.

methods.name: isTimeout
methods.description: Determines if the acknowledgment represents a timeout.

methods.name: getResponseType
methods.description: Returns the response type based on success status (RESPONSE or NACK).

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Retrieves the HTTP status code associated with the acknowledgment.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the optional payload as a JsonValue.

methods.name: setEntity
methods.description: Sets or updates the payload of the acknowledgment.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the acknowledgment into a JSON object with non-hidden fields.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns an empty JSON pointer indicating resource path.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Retrieves the entity ID associated with the acknowledgment.
